channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Allonzo Trier | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Allonzo Trier from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Mills on Allonzo Trier
item.description:
Adam Zagoria:Steve Mills on Allonzo Trier:

“I'm happy he didn't get drafted.... He had the PED situation in college but we had him come in,he spent 2 or 3 days with us... We felt like there was something beyond the problems he had in college... WE didn't expect him to move this quickly.”

Steve Mills on Allonzo Trier, Dec 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @AdamZagoria.

item.title: David Fizdale on Allonzo Trier
item.description:
Ian Begley:David Fizdale on Allonzo Trier:

“He feels like he has something to prove. In his heart, he believes he’s a 1st-round draft pick. He’s going out trying to show people that people messed up.”

David Fizdale on Allonzo Trier, Oct 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: David Fizdale on Allonzo Trier
item.description:
David Fizdale on if two-way player Allonzo Trier (25 pts, 8-for-12 shooting vs BKN) has a chance to make the 15-man roster on a standard NBA contract:

“We’re giving our spots to guys that earn them. Right now he’s earning it.”

David Fizdale on Allonzo Trier, Oct 4, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: David Fizdale on Kristaps Porzingis, Allonzo Trier, Mitchell Robinson, Kevin Knox
item.description:
Fizdale told Channel 4 New York's Bruce Beck.

“Kristaps (Porzingis) will come back healthy. He was already having a big time season last year when he got knocked down. We had an awesome draft with Kevin Knox, Mitchell Robinson, and Allonzo Trier - our two-way player.”

David Fizdale on Kristaps Porzingis, Allonzo Trier, Mitchell Robinson, Kevin Knox, Aug 23, 2018. Source: The Score.
